foreshore area means the land between a foreshore building line and the mean high water mark of an adjacent waterbody (natural).

fruit and produce picking, by a visitor to farm gate premises, means picking, gathering, selecting or otherwise harvesting fruit, vegetables and other agricultural products from the farm for purchase by the visitor.

grain bunker means a lined area in which grain is stored under a non-structural cover.

gross floor area has the same meaning as it has in the Standard Instrument. heritage conservation area means an area of land identified as a heritage conservation area or a place of Aboriginal heritage significance, including any heritage items situated on or within that area, in an environmental planning instrument.

high risk area means a high risk area identified in the council’s flood study or floodplain risk management study carried out in accordance with the Flood Risk Management Manual.
